description: Month-over-year solar yield and grid energy from waid-bucket-downsampled (daily totals). Live 24h boards still read raw waid-bucket.
title: Waid / Year comparison

panels.title: Solar this month
panels.description: Sum of daily yieldday (channel 0) since the 1st, in kWh.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")
start = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1mo)
from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: start)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "yieldday" and r["channel"] == "0")
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))

import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")
thisMonth = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1mo)
start = date.add(d: -1y, to: thisMonth)
stop = date.add(d: 1mo, to: start)
from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "yieldday" and r["channel"] == "0")
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))

panels.title: Monthly solar yield
panels.description: Daily yieldday summed per month, overlaid for this year / last year / two years ago. Set the picker to 12 months.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "yieldday" and r["channel"] == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0, _field: "this year" }))
  |> drop(columns: ["channel", "serial", "topic", "host"])

import "date"
from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: date.add(d: -1y, to: v.timeRangeStart), stop: date.add(d: -1y, to: v.timeRangeStop))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "yieldday" and r["channel"] == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> timeShift(duration: 1y)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0, _field: "last year" }))
  |> drop(columns: ["channel", "serial", "topic", "host"])

import "date"
from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: date.add(d: -2y, to: v.timeRangeStart), stop: date.add(d: -2y, to: v.timeRangeStop))
